title: 기술심리관규칙 / queue:ARTICLE:3:0:00003:part:1/1
full_text: Article 3 (Technical Fields and Number of Examiners) Technical examiners shall be assigned by technical field, such as machinery, electricity, or chemical engineering, and their total number shall not exceed 20. <Amended on December 14, 2005>
